nodes.label: OpenSpec CLI
nodes.rationale: Every OpenSpec workflow depends on the external `openspec` CLI (skills declare allowed-tools Bash(openspec:*)). The CLI is the source of truth for status, instructions, list, validate, and archive, so prompts must never hardcode artifact paths or bypass CLI-controlled state.

nodes.label: OpenSpec Store Selection Pattern
nodes.rationale: A store is a standalone OpenSpec repo registered on the machine. Workflows resolve store ids via `openspec store list --json` and pass `--store <id>` (sticky) on every spec/change-reading command so operations target the correct root instead of the nearest local `openspec/`.

nodes.label: OpenSpec Artifact-Driven Workflow
nodes.rationale: A change is planned as dependency-ordered artifacts (proposal -> specs -> design -> tasks). `status --json` and each artifact's `requires` edges drive what may be created next; `context` and `rules` are constraints for the agent and must never be copied into output files.
